description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Rammus''' [[File:Taunt icon.png|20px|link=Taunt|An icon representing the keyword Taunt]] [[:Taunt|taunts]] the target enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] for a duration. Monsters are additionally dealt magic damage upon being affected.
description.text: Active: Rammus taunts the target enemy champion or monster for a duration. Monsters are additionally dealt magic damage upon being affected.

notes.raw: * ''Frenzying Taunt'', despite being usable on [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], does not force them to attack '''Rammus'''. He does not draw aggro since the ability does not deal damage. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Frenzying Taunt, despite being usable on monsters, does not force them to attack Rammus. He does not draw aggro since the ability does not deal damage.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
